facts.title: Keys in the macOS Keychain
facts.body: SSH keys and passwords stay on your Mac, with Secure Enclave and 1Password support.

facts.title: No agent on your servers
facts.body: Capstio connects over standard SSH, straight from your Mac to your VPS.

facts.title: End-to-end encrypted team vault
facts.body: Shared hosts, keys and recipes are encrypted on your devices; the server stores only ciphertext.

keys.label: The tools, one key each
keys.hint: Click a key or drag the boat. With a key in focus, press 1 to 0.
